title: Ciara Says Her 9-Year-Old Daughter Nearly Spoiled Baby No. 5 Surprise: ‘She’s Got This Sixth Sense’
summary: The singer revealed that Sienna had a pretty convincing hunch about the growing family -- and she wasn't the only kid with questions.
body: Ciara says she’s no match for her 9-year-old daughter with a sixth sense. Before the singer and Russell Wilson officially broke the news to their kids that they’re expecting baby No. 5, daughter Sienna had already started putting the pieces together. Related Ciara Is Pregnant, Expecting Baby No. 5 With Russell Wilson Ciara Revisits ‘Goodies,’ ‘Oh,’ ‘Ride,’ ‘Body Party’ & More | Chart History Ciara Presents Kehlani With the Impact Award | Billboard Women In Music 2026 In a new interview with Entertainment Tonight published Tuesday, Ciara shared that Sienna somehow sensed that her family was about to grow pretty soon — even before there was a visible baby bump. “Sienna told me that I was pregnant before I told [the kids],” Ciara said. According to the singer, Sienna has a history of picking up on her pregnancies before her siblings, and this time was definitely no different. “She told me early on, but my stomach was not big.
